items.headline: Vitalik Backs $TRUE as Trueo Migrates to Ethereum
items.summary: Onchain prediction market Trueo moved to Ethereum, with Vitalik Buterin calling $TRUE a decentralized, ethical contender that is 'not corposlop.'

items.headline: Galaxy Buys $SKY, Adds $100M sUSDS to Treasury
items.summary: Galaxy added $100M of Sky's sUSDS to its treasury, bought $SKY tokens, and approved the savings token as institutional loan collateral with a 3.6% yield.

items.headline: Circle's BTC-Backed Lending on $MORPHO Jumps 10x
items.summary: The cirBTC market on Arc hit $14.3M of USDC borrowed via $MORPHO, up from $1.37M in days, with Galaxy and Keyrock supplying nearly all the liquidity.

items.headline: $ONDO Opens In-Kind Minting for Tokenized Stocks
items.summary: $ONDO now lets approved institutions swap existing share inventory for tokenized US stocks through Alpaca, removing the cash funding step from issuance.

items.headline: Kalshi Denies Faking Its Crypto Volume
items.summary: Kalshi says the repeating trade size behind wash-trading accusations came from a single paid market maker losing money to faster traders — not fake volume.
